research_scope: Official public Sunburst MSP, supplier, VMS, education and healthcare/government service pages, plus Amergis Education teletherapy.
method: Read six publicly linked official pages. No credentials, form submissions, private records or hidden endpoint enumeration.
interpretation: Observed means a claim printed on the official public page, not independent confirmation of software implementation or contractual service levels. Proposed workflows, schemas and AI authority are independent design recommendations.

evidence.claim: Describes an MSP with a dedicated program manager, tailored recruitment strategy, and dashboards for staffing and spend.
evidence.location: On-the-Ground Support; Tailored Solutions; Visibility and Transparency

evidence.claim: Says workforce experts combine AI innovation with practical services, but does not identify AI products, algorithms or delegated decisions.
Positions the supplier network as spanning agency affiliations.
evidence.location: A network as diverse as your needs

evidence.claim: Offers VMS partner selection according to customer fit; it does not identify one universal proprietary backend.
evidence.location: The right technology for your team; An approach you can trust

evidence.claim: Describes consolidated supplier invoices, spend and fill-rate analytics, supplier performance reporting, position management, candidate vetting, and credential/onboarding tracking.
Describes supplier matching by industry and region, specialist coverage, and supplier-diversity objectives.
evidence.location: Better alignment; Diversity in action; Niche roles, filled

evidence.claim: Published supplier expectations cover quality, compliance, responsiveness, collaboration, candidate experience and growth.
evidence.location: What we look for in a supplier

evidence.claim: The public joining action leads to contact; no qualification scoring rubric or executable onboarding process is disclosed.
evidence.location: Become a Sunburst Supplier; Apply to join our supplier network

evidence.claim: For districts, describes onboarding, compliance, vendor coordination, simplified contracting and consolidated billing.
evidence.location: Less admin, more impact through Consolidate vendor billing & invoices

evidence.claim: Explicitly names MatterWorx as a VMS used for consolidated invoices, spend/fill-rate reporting and credential tracking.
Claims no cost to school districts; this is a marketing description rather than proof of total economic incidence.
Names a Vice President of Business Development role. The adjacent three team entries are placeholders, so they are excluded from personnel counts.
Describes clinical and healthcare leadership guiding labor-mix planning across health systems, individual facilities and public-sector programs.
evidence.location: Workforce solutions tailored to you; Why partners choose us

evidence.claim: Says its public-sector services are funded through agency fees and supported by vetted suppliers, credentialing and onboarding.
evidence.location: Compliance-first mindset; Cost-neutral model; Reduced agency spend

evidence.claim: Describes school speech-language and psychological sessions accessed through permanent secure room links without student accounts or downloads, plus waiting rooms.
Lists collaborative whiteboards, document sharing, Boom Cards and Super Duper resources.
Lists in-platform Pearson assessments for SLP and psychology, in-call instructions and printable protocols.
Describes therapy-minute/session-completion tracking and activity reporting for documentation and billing, with technical support.

Claims HIPAA/FERPA compliance and no storage of student session data. Public copy does not reconcile reporting with its storage claim or disclose retention, data-flow architecture or assessment licensing.

workforce_role_map.note: Only title presence is evidenced; duties here are proposed.
Supplier organization is explicit; internal job titles are inferred.

material_unknowns: None of these pages discloses production tables, credentials, private client/candidate records or transaction-level data.
MatterWorx is explicitly named on one education page; generic VMS language supports partner variation rather than one backend.
Sunburst's AI language does not establish which workflows it already automates.
Agency-funded fees do not establish that every client contract is economically cost-neutral.
Marketing compliance claims have not been audited.
Teletherapy's no-session-data-storage claim needs a vendor data-flow and retention explanation before designing reporting or AI documentation.
Human-authority recommendations are product design controls, not a completed legal analysis for every jurisdiction.
The public pages have no visible publication dates; footer years and crawler dates are not treated as document dates.
